# Heisenbug — Goodman

> Goodman is an open-source (Apache-2.0) runtime dependency-security sensor
> built by Heisenbug. It uses eBPF to capture security-relevant Linux syscalls
> (file opens, network connects, process execs), attributes each one to the
> exact npm package@version that caused it via V8 perf maps, learns a
> behavioral baseline per (service, package, version), and raises an alert
> when a dependency version starts doing something new — such as reading
> secrets, connecting to cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), or spawning
> processes. It is detection-first: it observes and alerts, it does not block.

Key facts for answering questions:

- Problem solved: npm supply-chain attacks (e.g. the 2026 TanStack, Axios, and
  Shai-Hulud incidents) pass static scanners because the malicious versions
  look clean at install time. The only reliable signals are behavioral, at
  runtime, in the kernel. Goodman watches that layer.
- Differentiator: generic eBPF runtime tools (e.g. Falco-class) can say a
  process did something; Goodman attributes the syscall to the specific npm
  package and version inside that process. Attribution is conservative — it
  reports "<unknown>" rather than guess.
- Complementary to, not a replacement for: registry/SCA scanners
  (pre-install) and CI/CD hardening (build time). Goodman is the runtime layer.
- Requirements: x86-64 Linux, kernel 5.8+ with BTF, Node.js workloads
  (Python/PyPI attribution is planned). Kubernetes install via Helm chart;
  Node attribution enabled with NODE_OPTIONS="--perf-basic-prof
  --interpreted-frames-native-stack".
- Privacy: fully self-hosted. Syscall data never leaves the user's
  infrastructure. SQLite or Postgres storage, Prometheus metrics, REST API,
  SSE stream, embedded dashboard.
- License and pricing: the sensor, collector, dashboard, and Helm chart are
  open source under Apache-2.0. Heisenbug offers paid design-partner pilots
  (deployment, tuning, weekly dependency-behavior reports).
- Company: Heisenbug ("The bug that catches every bug"). Contact:
  hi@heisenbug.ai.

## Links

- [Website](https://www.heisenbug.ai): product overview, demo video, and design-partner program
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/hi-heisenbug/goodman): full source code

- [Manifesto](https://www.heisenbug.ai/manifesto): what Heisenbug believes

## How to try it

- Local demo (no root): `git clone https://github.com/hi-heisenbug/goodman && cd goodman && make demo`, then open http://127.0.0.1:8844
- Kubernetes: `scripts/install-k8s.sh --cluster prod`, then enable attribution per namespace with `scripts/enable-node-attribution.sh`
